observations: Two retail boxes for 'FOR Switchgear Wireless Controller' are shown.
The boxes feature a clear window displaying a white controller with green and yellow accents.
The controller has a 'X6' logo on the top right of the box.
A power cable with a UK-style three-pin plug is visible.
The actual controllers are not shown outside of the packaging.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME ARENAOFFICIAL' is present on the image.

claims.evidence: The controller is not a PlayStation 4 Pro; it is a generic 'FOR Switchgear' brand.

risks.risk: The controller may be a generic clone rather than the official 'FOR Switchgear' brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label on the bottom of the controller.

risks.risk: The controller may have internal faults or be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being connected to a PS4 Pro and successfully navigating a game.

risks.risk: The power cable may be damaged or have a faulty connector.
risks.proof: A video showing the cable being plugged into a power source and the controller powering on.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom of the controller showing the brand and model label.
Video of the controller being used to play a game on a PS4 Pro.
Photo of the controller with the power cable unplugged to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
